title: examples: dataset members carry a description and bundle translations, not synonyms alone
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6947282338, gap 1); the filer did not re-read the code behind it. Source: that seat's amendment 6947260430 on #34718.

## Why

The examples are what an author copies. After #34718 their members have synonyms and no description, so the copy teaches half of the vocabulary and the advisory stays quiet about it.

## Evidence

- Per the report: the examples' dataset members carry `synonyms` only; adding `description` (a translation key) and bundle translations as app-crm did moves the i18n-coverage baseline (app-todo: 9 members, 106 → 124).

## Scope

- Each example dataset member gains a description and its bundle translations; the i18n-coverage baseline moves with it, stated in the PR.
- File surface: `examples/**`.

## Done when

- Every example dataset member has both keys; `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` is green on the new baseline.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34718.
